extDescription.message: Switch accounts on Supabase, Vercel, GitHub and 160+ sites in one click — or every app of a client at once. No signing out.

commandNext.message: Switch to the next account of the current site

commandPrevious.message: Switch to the previous account of the current site

commandNewLogin.message: Sign in to the current site with another account

commandWorkspaceNext.message: Switch to the next workspace (all its apps at once)

commandSidePanel.message: Open Swapdeck in the side panel
